item.title: Music Beneath the Radio Calls

turns.text: Add a tense instrumental bed to this. Keep it under the radio calls so every word is easy to hear, especially 'Rook, you with me?' Don't change the footage.

item.tests: Tests whether added music remains audibly subordinate to the original speech, with intelligibility preserved throughout the delivered video.

answer_sheet.Music mood and vocals: Tense instrumental music, with no singing.
answer_sheet.Music level relative to speech: Clearly quieter than the radio calls whenever someone speaks; every original word must remain easy to hear.
answer_sheet.Source footage, duration, and framing: Keep the entire attached 7-second cockpit clip, with unchanged visuals, timing, and framing.
answer_sheet.Speech and added text: Keep the original radio-call recording in sync. Do not replace it or add text.

must_haves: The output preserves all seven seconds of the original cockpit footage without visual changes or extra shots.
A tense instrumental music bed is audible, with no added singing.
The original radio calls remain present and synchronized, including the clearly intelligible line 'Rook, you with me?'
During every spoken line, the music is perceptibly below the voice and does not mask words with loud beats, swells, or accents.
The music is not simply muted for the entire clip; it is audible while remaining subordinate to speech.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 5 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it 2 seconds shorter and keep everything else the same.

turns.text: Add a tense instrumental bed to this. Keep it under the radio calls so every word is easy to hear, especially 'Rook, you with me?' Don't change the footage.

dialog.agent:
I can help create the instrumental, but the connected tools can’t mix it into your MP4 or duck it under dialogue while leaving the footage unchanged. I haven’t modified your file.

The mix should use a restrained, tense instrumental with no vocals, kept low beneath all radio calls and dipped further around **“Rook, you with me?”** An audio/video editor is needed to apply that mix without regenerating the footage.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

dialog.agent:
Free settings don’t remove the limitation: the connected tools can generate music, but can’t mix it beneath your radio calls while preserving the footage. I won’t regenerate the video or risk changing it.

I can make a **separate tense instrumental track** for you to add in an editor. How long is the clip? The music generator’s minimum is 15 seconds.

turns.agent:
The music generation was refused because your account has insufficient credits. **No track was created, and your video is unchanged.**

The minimum 15-second instrumental costs **15 credits**, even though your clip is only 7 seconds. Mixing it beneath the radio calls would still require an audio/video editor.

approvals.name: generate_music

style.prompt: A restrained tense cinematic instrumental underscore designed to sit underneath seven seconds of radio dialogue. Establish quiet suspense immediately, with a soft low drone, subtle dark ambient textures and a very gentle muted pulse. Consistent sparse arrangement that can be trimmed at seven seconds. No vocals, no speech, no radio effects, no loud percussion, no sharp transients, no stingers, no dramatic swells, no lead melody. Leave ample midrange space for clear spoken words. Understated and controlled, never overpowering.
